answer: Cheap identities are pruned like water vanishing into karst, leaving only paid participants. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work challenge tied to its reputation slot, so launching N sybils costs N times the stake plus compute. Any attempt to bridge multiple fake accounts collapses under the shared collateral requirement, and a lone sparrow of a genuine agent outlasts the flock of impostors because forgery is economically irrational. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
